name: pstack_spawn
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_spawn that spawns one isolated Pi child agent.
verification: test@tests/layers/02-integration/extension-load.test.mjs@pstack tools are registered

obligation: Require a non-empty task string as the only mandatory spawn parameter and reject calls that omit it.
verification: todo@unit test that the pstack_spawn schema rejects a call without task

obligation: Default the child role to general and build a per-role prompt that wraps poteto-agent, comment-sicko, and investigator inputs while leaving other roles as the raw task.
verification: todo@assert the role default and per-role prompt construction for poteto-agent, comment-sicko, investigator, and general

obligation: Accept an explicit model only as provider/id or inherit-parent/auto and refuse an unmapped bare marketing slug.
verification: todo@model-selector test covering provider/id, inherit-parent, auto, and rejection of a bare slug

obligation: Resolve an omitted model through the role model config and fall back to the parent model when the role has no configured value.
verification: todo@spawn a role with a configured model and assert the child resolves it over the parent model

obligation: Resolve the child tool allowlist in the order explicit tools, readonly or auto-readonly role, then inherited parent tools, else full discovery.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveTools follows explicit, readonly, auto-readonly, and inherit order

obligation: Treat an explicit background as decisive, and an omitted background as detached only for the poteto-agent role or an explicit poteto flag; every other role is synchronous by default.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@only poteto-agent detaches by default

obligation: Persist full child output by default for background or five-minute-plus children and honor the explicit and PSTACK_PERSIST_OUTPUT overrides.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@shouldPersistOutput resolves explicit, env, and timeout defaults

obligation: Accept only isolated or ephemeral for sessionMode and default to isolated when unset or unrecognized.
verification: todo@exercise sessionMode isolated and ephemeral plus an invalid value falling back to isolated

obligation: Mint a fresh isolated session directory under the child cwd and reject resume combined with ephemeral.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveChildSessionDir rejects resume plus ephemeral and mints isolated dirs

obligation: Fail closed when resumeSessionDir or resumeJobId names a missing target or a job without a recorded session directory.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@resolveResumeSessionDirParam fails closed on unknown and dir-less jobs

obligation: Clamp timeoutMs to the allowed range and default it to 600000 milliseconds.
verification: todo@assert timeoutMs clamps within 1000 to 1800000 and defaults to 600000

obligation: Build the child argv in json mode with --model, a session flag, --continue only when resuming, and the prompt last.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@buildChildPiArgs marks resume with continue and leaves fresh isolated without it

obligation: Pass the parent model and child role into the child environment as PSTACK_PARENT_MODEL and PSTACK_CHILD_ROLE.
verification: todo@probe the child env for PSTACK_PARENT_MODEL and PSTACK_CHILD_ROLE

obligation: Never inherit the parent conversation history into the child process.
verification: todo@assert the child argv and env carry no parent transcript reference

obligation: Never inherit the parent MCP bindings into the child process.
verification: todo@assert the child receives no parent MCP configuration

obligation: Enforce a global child concurrency cap defaulting to 8 and clamp the PSTACK_MAX_CONCURRENCY override to 1 through 32.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@childConcurrencyStats reports the idle cap and task ceiling

obligation: Deliver the background completion as a follow-up message carrying the job id, role, model, exit code, and sessionDir.
verification: todo@spawn a background child and assert the follow-up includes sessionDir

obligation: Return the foreground result inline as a pstack_spawn summary with role, model, exit code, and sessionDir.
verification: todo@spawn with background:false and assert the reply text and details

obligation: Resolve synchronous execution for routed skills that consume a child result inline (how, why, interrogate, reflect, no-comments), either by passing background:false at those call sites or by resolving the default to sync for those roles.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@only poteto-agent detaches by default

name: pstack_jobs
obligation: Register a tool named pstack_jobs that lists, polls, awaits, and aborts detached spawn jobs.
verification: test@tests/layers/02-integration/extension-load.test.mjs@scripted tool call executes

obligation: Accept action list, status, await, abort, or cancel and require an id for every action except list.
verification: todo@exercise each action and assert unknown actions and missing ids throw

obligation: Print the list header with active, cap, and waiting counts and order rows by start time.
verification: todo@assert the list header format and startedAt ordering

obligation: Show status output truncated to 8000 characters and fail with unknown job for a missing id.
verification: todo@assert status truncation and the unknown job error

obligation: Await a job to a terminal state by polling and throw a timeout error when the deadline passes.
verification: todo@assert await returns the terminal result and times out without leaking the job

obligation: Track each job through queued, running, done, failed, and aborted states and let abort flip a queued or running job to aborted.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/child-runner-units.test.ts@background job registry lists, aborts, and clears jobs

obligation: Keep job records queryable across follow-ups within the session and abort all jobs on session shutdown.
verification: todo@prove jobs persist within a session and disappear after session shutdown
